description:
An mpv-based video player for studying Japanese.


For the best experience install [Noto Sans CJK JP](https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-cjk/raw/main/Sans/Variable/TTF/NotoSansCJKjp-VF.ttf) and [Kanji Stroke Order](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1oyQoTB531tbhlYaOW7ugvutXZ7HSlJfW) fonts.

# Change Log

• Optionally show furigana above subtitles
• Make `{furigana}` and `{furigana-plain}` only show furigana over kanji when possible
• Add the option to set explicit dark and light themes on Windows and macOS
• Improve glossary rendering
  • Add support for `<details>` tags
  • Add support for monochrome images
• Switch render backend from OpenGL to D3D11 on Windows
• Allow custom mpv OSCs to handle mouse inputs
• Keep player maximized when exiting fullscreen instead of always returning to windowed
• Fix JSON audio sources sometimes breaking the add to Anki button
• Fix file type filtering in **Add Subtitle** @karolba 
• Fix black flashing when resizing the window on macOS

# Important for macOS users
• Streaming does not work out of the box. To enable streaming, [follow the steps for installing yt-dlp in the README.](https://github.com/ripose-jp/Memento#macos-streaming-video-doesnt-work)
